verdict.rationale: Appwrite ships a well-documented official CLI (installation, full command reference, headless/non-interactive mode for CI/automation, type/SDK generation, JSON includes, endpoint flags for self-hosting) that directly supports agentic/automated workflows and is explicitly designed to be scriptable without interactive sessions, which fits AI-native usage patterns. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the CLI in practice, and explicit documentation of AI-agent-specific CLI features beyond general automation support.
